research.ancient.001.name: Conjure
research.ancient.001.description: The magic of this spell will conjure a random item of minor significance, but it may be significant dependent on the caster's current motivations. Due to the creative nature of the spell, something needs to be destroyed in turn. That means that the spell scroll will always crumble to dust when cast.
research.ancient.002.name: Death Speak
research.ancient.002.description: This spell allows you to communicate with recently slain supernatural foes. If you can speak to their souls, you have the potential to restore a part of yourself. The restoration goes in order of mana, stamina, and health. The amount restored is dependent on the power of the caster and the fame of the slain creature. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.003.name: Sneak
research.ancient.003.description: Hides the target and allows them to sneak around for 2-8 minutes. They can still be discovered, however, and they cannot sneak well in heavy armor.
research.ancient.004.name: Create Fire
research.ancient.004.description: Creates a magical fire at the caster's feet. When anything approaches the fire, they will take 2-20 points of fire damage every couple of seconds. The magical fire can last between 15-200 seconds dependent on the power of the caster.
research.ancient.005.name: Electrical Elemental
research.ancient.005.description: Summons an electrial elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.006.name: Confusion Blast
research.ancient.006.description: Those within the confusion blast could suffer from the effects for 5-20 seconds before they regain their senses.
research.ancient.007.name: See Truth
research.ancient.007.description: This magic is an ancient form of that which gypsies use to see the truth in things. If you cast this spell on a book or parchment that you feel may be falsely written, you may learn the truth of things.
research.ancient.008.name: Icicle
research.ancient.008.description: Throws a magical icicle at your enemies that can cause up to 80 points of cold damage.
research.ancient.009.name: Extinguish
research.ancient.009.description: Calls forth waves of water that can cause up to 12-125 points of cold and physical damage. It will do twice the amount of damage toward creatures that suffer from flame extinguishing enchanted weapons.
research.ancient.010.name: Rock Flesh
research.ancient.010.description: With this spell, the caster gains an innate resistance to damage by transforming the very flesh into a substance as strong as stone for 1-16 minutes of a 90% physical resistance. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.011.name: Mass Might
research.ancient.011.description: Increases the casters strength for up to 8 minutes, and it will also affect the caster's allies that are no more than 10 spaces away.
research.ancient.012.name: Endure Cold
research.ancient.012.description: Increases the casters cold resistance for up to 8 minutes, and it will also affect the caster's allies that are no more than 3 spaces away.
research.ancient.013.name: Weed Elemental
research.ancient.013.description: Summons a weed elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.014.name: Spawn Creatures
research.ancient.014.description: Summons random creatures that are controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.015.name: Healing Touch
research.ancient.015.description: Heals the one touched, restoring 12-125 hit points. You need to be close to your target, however.
research.ancient.016.name: Snow Ball
research.ancient.016.description: Throws a magical snow ball toward your enemy, which can cause 2-80 points of cold damage.
research.ancient.017.name: Clone
research.ancient.017.description: Creates a clone of the caster that will appear and distract your enemies while you remain hidden from view.
research.ancient.018.name: Grant Peace
research.ancient.018.description: This spell can grant an undead creature the true and final death. If they cannot be laid to rest, then they may take 50-200 points of energy damage.
research.ancient.019.name: Sleep
research.ancient.019.description: This spell can put a foe to sleep from 10-60 seconds, but taking actions against them will likely wake them up from their slumber. This spell cannot affect supernatural creatures, constructs, golems, or elementals.
research.ancient.020.name: Endure Heat
research.ancient.020.description: Increases the casters fire resistance for up to 8 minutes, and it will also affect the caster's allies that are no more than 3 spaces away.
research.ancient.021.name: Ice Elemental
research.ancient.021.description: Summons an ice elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.022.name: Ethereal Travel
research.ancient.022.description: Caster is transported to the location marked on the recall rune. One can use this spell on a ship key to travel to a boat's location if the boat is not dry docked. The caster will appear at the destination in a hidden state.
research.ancient.023.name: Wizard Eye
research.ancient.023.description: This spell allows the caster to identify items that have origins that are unknown to others.
research.ancient.024.name: Frost Field
research.ancient.024.description: Creates a wall of frost that can cause 2-16 points of cold damage per second to anyone within it.
research.ancient.025.name: Create Gold
research.ancient.025.description: Originally created by the fiendish imp Rumpelstiltskin, this spell allows the caster to turn armor or weapons into gold. They can also transmute varying ingots into golden ingots, as well as turn coins into golden coins. Coins will often be destroyed during the transmutation process, but the better the skill of the archmage the less that is lost. This spell is powerful enough that the scroll will always crumble to dust when cast.
research.ancient.026.name: Animate Bones
research.ancient.026.description: Animates the bones of a mighty skeletal warrior that will fight for the caster for 8-25 minutes. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.027.name: Cause Fear
research.ancient.027.description: The caster can cause fear in a foe, causing them to flee from you for 10-60 seconds. This spell does not work on golems or constructs.
research.ancient.028.name: Ignite
research.ancient.028.description: Calls forth columns of fire that can cause up to 15-125 points of fire and physical damage. It will do twice the amount of damage toward creatures that suffer from watery grave or neptune's bane enchanted weapons.
research.ancient.029.name: Mud Elemental
research.ancient.029.description: Summons a mud elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.030.name: Banish Daemon
research.ancient.030.description: This spell can send a demonic creature back to the plane of hell from which they spawned. If they cannot be banished, then they may take 50-200 points of energy damage.
research.ancient.031.name: Fade from Sight
research.ancient.031.description: This spell will cause the caster to fade from the view of others, while at the same time moving them to a different location.
research.ancient.032.name: Gas Cloud
research.ancient.032.description: Creates a gaseous cloud of poison mist that will consume nearby enemies in the venomous vapor for 1-3 minutes.
research.ancient.033.name: Swarm
research.ancient.033.description: Unleashes a swarm of insects at your enemies for 1-3 minutes.
research.ancient.034.name: Mask of Death
research.ancient.034.description: Creates a mask for the caster that when worn the undead will see you as one of their own and ignore them. The mask remains on this plane of existence for 6-15 minutes before it returns to the realm from which it came. If you attack an undead creature while wearing the mask, it will vanish and you will have to face your foe. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.035.name: Enchant
research.ancient.035.description: This can greatly increase a weapon's damage by enchanting it for 15-60 minutes. A power orb is summoned and placed in the caster's pack that gives the enchantment strength until the spell wears off.
research.ancient.036.name: Flame Bolt
research.ancient.036.description: Throws a magical bolt of flame at your enemies that can cause 12-100 points of fire damage.
research.ancient.037.name: Gem Elemental
research.ancient.037.description: Summons a gem rock elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.038.name: Call Destruction
research.ancient.038.description: Damages nearby enemies with an destructive force that causes mostly physical harm and some damage from energy. If you hit more than one enemy, the damage amount is doubled and divided amongst each enemy evenly. The damage dealt is between 8-50 points, with the addition of half the available hit points of the caster. After the destruction is unleashed, the caster will lose half of their remaining hit points.
research.ancient.039.name: Divination
research.ancient.039.description: One can cast this spell on most creatures and learn things about them that are not commonly know by others.
research.ancient.040.name: Frost Strike
research.ancient.040.description: Damages an enemy with a column of frost crystals that causes 35-125 points of cold damage.
research.ancient.041.name: Magic Steed
research.ancient.041.description: Lures a horse to the caster's location where it can be ridden for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.042.name: Create Golem
research.ancient.042.description: Creates a mighty flesh golem that will follow the commands of the cast for 8-25 minutes. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.043.name: Sleep Field
research.ancient.043.description: This spell will create a field that will put entering foes to sleep for 10-60 seconds, but taking actions against them will likely wake them up from their slumber. This spell cannot affect supernatural creatures, constructs, golems, or elementals.
research.ancient.044.name: Conflagration
research.ancient.044.description: Creates a huge inferno that can cause 2-16 points of fire damage per second to anyone within it.
research.ancient.045.name: Acid Elemental
research.ancient.045.description: Summons an acid elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.046.name: Meteor Shower
research.ancient.046.description: Damages nearby enemies with falling meteorites that hit for physical damage (with some fire and energy damage) split between the enemies. If you only hit one enemy, the enemy takes between 35-125 points of damage, but if you hit more than one enemy, the damage amount is doubled and divided amongst each enemy evenly.
research.ancient.047.name: Intervention
research.ancient.047.description: This is one of those rare spells that call upon the favor of the gods. When the spell is invoked, the caster is empowered with 10-50 additional points in their resistances. They are also protected from magery spell attack damage for 25-125 points. The effects last between 10-50 minutes.
research.ancient.048.name: Hail Storm
research.ancient.048.description: Creates a storm of ice around an enemy, causing 28-125 points of cold damage.
research.ancient.049.name: Aerial Servant
research.ancient.049.description: Calls upon a mystical servant from the ethereal plane to aid the caster by carrying items for 1-3 hours.
research.ancient.050.name: Open Ground
research.ancient.050.description: Opens a huge hole in the ground that can cause anyone that goes near it to fall in. Creatures may fall to their deaths and never be seen again, while advenuterers will fall into the huge chasm below. If an adventurer has comrades, familiars, summons, or tamed beasts that stumble into the chasm, then the adventurer will fall in after them. This spell is powerful enough that the scroll will always crumble to dust when cast. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.051.name: Charm
research.ancient.051.description: This spell can charm either aggressive monsters or those of animialistic natures. When charmed, their evil or neutral tendencies are wiped from their mind and they will attack evil creatures. This charm will only last for up to a minute before they come to their senses.
research.ancient.052.name: Explosion
research.ancient.052.description: Damages nearby enemies with an explosive force consisting of mostly heat and some physical damage. If you only hit one enemy, the enemy takes between 35-125 points of damage, but if you hit more than one enemy, the damage amount is doubled and divided amongst each enemy evenly.
research.ancient.053.name: Poison Elemental
research.ancient.053.description: Summons a poison elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.054.name: Invoke Devil
research.ancient.054.description: Calls forth a devil from the realms of hell to serve the caster for 2-8 minutes. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this.
research.ancient.055.name: Air Walk
research.ancient.055.description: This spell creates an apple high cushion of air under the caster's feet for 20-80 minutes. When moving on this cushion of air, the caster can avoid almost any floor trap even if they are hidden. It does not help the caster avoid stone face traps or exploding mushrooms, nor does it avoid traps placed on containers. Any harmful liquids on a floor can also be avoided.
research.ancient.056.name: Avalanche
research.ancient.056.description: Damages nearby enemies with falling ice and snow that hit for cold damage split between the enemies. If you only hit one enemy, the enemy takes between 35-125 points of damage, but if you hit more than one enemy, the damage amount is doubled and divided amongst each enemy evenly.
research.ancient.057.name: Death Vortex
research.ancient.057.description: Creates a swirling mass of black death that spreads disease and unleashes electrical force on nearby enemies for 1-3 minutes.
research.ancient.058.name: Withstand Death
research.ancient.058.description: This spell was lost to the ages, but legends tell of King Wolfgang learning the secrets of this spell and creating the gem of immortality. The caster, if they can find all of the reagents needed, should be able to create a gem almost similar to that. If one is holding the jewel that is created, and they meet an untimely end, they will be restored to full health instead as the jewel vanishes from this plane of existence. You will need a sapphire to imbue the magic in for this spell to work. This spell is powerful enough that the scroll will always crumble to dust when cast.
research.ancient.059.name: Mass Sleep
research.ancient.059.description: This spell will cause nearby foes to sleep for 10-60 seconds, but taking actions against them will likely wake them up from their slumber. This spell cannot affect supernatural creatures, constructs, golems, or elementals. This spell is powerful enough that the scroll will always crumble to dust when cast.
research.ancient.060.name: Ring of Fire
research.ancient.060.description: This spell creates a ring of fire at a chosen location, where demonic creatures cannot pass. Any demonic creature that touches the flames will be unable to cast spells, but they may still perform any special attacks they may have. The ring can last up to 50 seconds before extinguishing itself, and there is a chance that the demon can traverse the flaming circle if cast on uneven terrain.
research.ancient.061.name: Blood Elemental
research.ancient.061.description: Summons a blood elemental that is controlled by the caster for 8-25 minutes.
research.ancient.062.name: Armageddon
research.ancient.062.description: Over 700,000 years ago, the Xorinite Wisp gave the original version of this spell to a mage named Zog who was foolish enough to cast it, and all life was destroyed. What Zog may have done to enhance the spell is unknown, but this one is a much more minor version of that spell. Once it is cast, it destroys all creatures (often destroying their corpses) in a 20 space radius. It also kills the one casting it. Only the biggest fool, full of madness, would dare to cast this spell. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this and the spell is powerful enough that the scroll will always crumble to dust when cast.
research.ancient.063.name: Restoration
research.ancient.063.description: This spell can restore 12-125 points in health, stamina, and mana.
research.ancient.064.name: Mass Death
research.ancient.064.description: Damages nearby enemies with deathly magics summoned from the void. If you hit more than one enemy, the damage amount is doubled and divided amongst each enemy evenly. The damage dealt is between 45-125 points, with the addition of the available hit points of the caster. After the mass death is unleashed, the caster will have a single hit point remaining. The caster may lose some karma if they attempt this. This spell is powerful enough that the scroll will always crumble to dust when cast.
